short: a picture in passes: switch models, lock and enlarge

about.zh: 一张图分几步画时有哪几种路子：同一张图前后段换模型（换的时候可以顺手放大）、锁住原图再放大重画（可以顺手换成同类的第二个模型）、画完换模型接着修；什么时候必须是同一类模型，你选的画风 LoRA 要不要一起挂到第二个模型上。只说怎么做，具体数值在做法里；你存过的路线卡和搭配优先原样用，你没选的画风和 LoRA 不加。
about.en: The ways to make one picture in passes: different models for its early and late steps (which may enlarge at the switch), a locked redraw while enlarging (which may switch to a second model of the same family), and model after model; when the models must be of one family, and whether your style LoRA goes onto the second model too. How, not values: those live in the ways. A route card or combo you saved comes first, as it is; no style or LoRA you did not pick.

text: Use when the user wants a picture made in passes, or one model for the composition and another for the look (style, skin, texture); not a default for every picture.

A route the user saved is the daily run: a workflow card (list_workflows; "name / preset" when it has presets) or a combo (list_combos), with their subject and seed; its models, LoRAs and values are theirs, unchanged. Another route is another card. Never add a style, artist or LoRA the user did not pick.

Show the first pass before the second, so the user can pick the base: run_workflow with base_only=true (and batch for a few to choose from) runs that pass alone as previews; Anomalous shows them to the user, keeps the one picked and holds its seed, so the next run_workflow runs the whole workflow on that base. Keep the picked base to compare. Without base_only, hold the base's seed yourself (its sampler's control_after_generate "fixed", set before that first run): a seed that moves after each run makes the next run redraw a different base under the second pass.

Ways to stage, by what the user wants. Switch models within one picture: the early steps settle the composition on one model, the later steps finish it on another (add_nodes use="refine", want="midway"); the switch may also enlarge the picture, so the later steps draw its detail at the larger size in place of an upscale pass after it (the way's next step says how; the second model may then be the same one). Enlarge with a lock: a guide holding the picture (Tile) lets the redraw go much stronger, adding detail while the composition holds; without one a strong redraw moves the pose and ornaments. The locked redraw (use="upscale", want="detail") has its own copy of the model, the base's by default; swap it for a second model of the same family for a steadier enlargement or better skin and texture: one redraw, no extra refine pass after it. Model after model: one finishes, the next lightly redraws the whole picture (use="refine"); a chain of several is fine.

Families: a switch that reuses the first stage's prompts and VAE needs a second model of the same family (sharing the text encoder and VAE): the mid-way switch, the second-model upscale, and the refine on a model split into UNET, text encoder and VAE files (Anima). The refine with a checkpoint of its own (its own CLIP and VAE, on the decoded picture) may cross families: rewrite its positive and negative prompts in the new family's way. A combination not tried here: say it is untried.

The second model is loaded bare. When the first stage has a style LoRA the user picked and they want that look kept, borrowing only the second model's skin or detail, add_lora it onto the second model too; leave it off only when they want the look changed. Never add one they did not pick.

These ways come from a few single-seed comparisons. A strong redraw changes faces, hands and small ornaments even with a lock: say what ran and what changed; promise no exact reproduction and no repaired hands.
